applicabilityBasis.summary: sUSDf is an ERC-4626 non-rebasing yield-vault share over USDf. Its exchange rate accrues yield and redemption returns a variable amount of USDf, rather than a fixed dollar or other monetary-value payment obligation. It is classified separately from the underlying token as a non-payment-token savings/strategy position; this is not an inherited GENIUS authorization or a finding that the underlying token is excluded.

genius.notes: sUSDf is treated as a non-payment token on its own yield-accruing vault rights, not because of crypto collateral or user geographic restrictions. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization or foreign exception is asserted. Parent USDf remains separately assessed as unclear/no-public-authorization-found. Falcon Digital Limited is named in the platform terms for Falcon assets; exact legal issuer spelling is kept consistent with USDf.
